diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5.2 V
diffs.evidence: Current Aosong AM2301 datasheet (V1.0, revision history '2020/12 V1.0 最初版本'): pin table '1 红色 VDD 电源 (3.3V-5.5V)'; section 3.1 'AM2301 的供电范围为 3.3-5.5V，推荐电压 5V'; electrical table VDD min/typ/max '3.3 5 5.5'; absolute max 'VDD to GND -0.3 5.5 V'; laser marking on sensor 'POWER: 3.3-5.5VDC'. The second reading used an older third-party copy (haoyuelectronics) that says 'Power (3.3V-5.2V)' — superseded by the manufacturer's current revision. Model keeps 5 V recommended.

diffs.diff: humidity_%RH: datasheet reading gives 0.1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 5.2 example: '湿度：00000010 10010010=0292H=658 => 湿度 = 65.8%RH' (0.1 %RH per count). The model does not declare raw-count constants because it has no custom register driver: it uses sim kind 'dht-sensor' and MicroPython's built-in dht.DHT22 class, which decodes humidity as 16-bit value x 0.1 — identical to the AM2301 format (buildNotes: 'humidity x10'). The example test confirms H=63.8% round-trips. Scaling is correct; nothing to declare.

diffs.diff: temperature_C: datasheet reading gives 0.1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 5.2 example: '温度：00000001 00001101=10DH=269 => 温度= 26.9℃'; '当温度低于0 ℃时温度数据的最高位置1。示例：-10.1 ℃表示为10000000 01100101'. MicroPython dht.DHT22 decodes temperature as (15-bit magnitude) x 0.1 with bit 15 as sign, matching exactly; the model's test checks T=-8.6C. The model uses the built-in decoder (sim kind 'dht-sensor'), so it has no explicit scale field; scaling is correct.
